findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 16 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 82 questions numbered 1-82; by section: 16.1 7, 16.2 12, 16.3 5, 16.4 7, 16.5 13, 16.6 8, 16.7 8, 16.8 9, 16.9 5, 16.10 8.

Covers sections 16.1-16.10 in order (introduction under 16.1); comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: minus sign in dV = -E dd, q in Eqs. 16.14-16.15, ln 2 = 0.693, energy x4 when V is doubled, and the fan capacitor shifts phase (it gives no extra power). eps0 is stated in the question where needed (the chapter gives no value).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
